title: Future Perfect Continuous
intro: Future perfect continuous: will have been + kata kerja -ing. Untuk menekankan lama sebuah kegiatan sampai titik tertentu di masa depan. By June I will have been working here for a year.

exercises.question: By June I ___ here for a year.
exercises.explanation: Rumusnya will have been + kata kerja -ing. Bentuknya been, bukan being.

exercises.question: She ___ for three hours by noon.
exercises.explanation: Will have been + studying. Will have tidak pernah menjadi will has.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with the future perfect continuous
exercises.sentence: They ___ (wait) for two hours by then.
exercises.explanation: Will have been + kata kerja -ing: will have been waiting.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with the future perfect continuous
exercises.sentence: He ___ (live) in Jakarta for ten years next month.
exercises.explanation: Will have been + living. Kata kerja berakhiran -e menghilangkan e sebelum -ing.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order
exercises.answer: We will have been driving for six hours
exercises.explanation: Subjek + will have been + kata kerja -ing + for + lama waktu.

exercises.prompt: Match each tense to its formula
exercises.explanation: Future perfect menekankan hasil yang selesai, sedangkan future perfect continuous menekankan lamanya kegiatan dengan been + -ing.

exercises.question: Pick the correct sentence.
options: I will have been reading for an hour.
I will have being reading for an hour.
I will have been read for an hour.
exercises.answer: I will have been reading for an hour.
exercises.explanation: Bentuknya been, dan kata kerja setelahnya harus berakhiran -ing: reading.

exercises.question: By May she will have been teaching ___ five years.
exercises.explanation: For dipakai untuk lama waktu seperti five years. Since dipakai untuk titik mulai.

exercises.task: Write one sentence about how long you will have been studying English by next year.
exercises.modelAnswer: By next year I will have been studying English for four years.
exercises.explanation: Gunakan will have been + kata kerja -ing, misalnya 'By next year I will have been studying English for four years.'
